fnol_text: My name is Rosa Castillo and I live at 896 Ashford Close, Madison, WI 53740. You can reach me on (555) 282-7450 or rosa.castillo@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 23 October 2023. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00085. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Castillo on (555) 282-7450 to acknowledge the claim. Rosa confirmed the loss date as 23 October 2023.
Site visit to 896 Ashford Close. Neighbour Valentina Vasquez was present and confirmed the timeline.
Rosa sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
